title: English Practice Quiz 0918
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They clean the room.'
options: The room is cleaned by them.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.
